description: Topi Rasku at VTT publishes a Spine Toolbox workflow that feeds SpineOpt with building data derived from AmBIENCe and Hotmaps. The native description identifies its role between AmBIENCe2ABM input processing and MOPO heat-sector postprocessing: it runs ArchetypeBuildingModel to calculate European heating and cooling time series for energy-system simulations. The archive contains project files, datastores, source code and input data. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0 for the general package, with bundled software retaining separate licences. Coverage is EU-wide building demand. The source warns that the workflow has not kept pace with recent Spine Toolbox and SpineInterface versions and requires separately obtained weather and floor-area data. Related records represent those upstream and downstream components. A limitation is that installation, compatibility and numerical output were not tested. No archive, code, README, raster or weather file was downloaded.
